responses.B-MSR-015:
Writing one offer message to all 300 past customers is a job for **customer-message-writer**, not this helper. This one sorts incoming messages and drafts replies to them. Please run your Diwali offer through customer-message-writer. Have these ready:

- Business name and what you clean
- The offer: 20% off Diwali deep-clean, valid till October 31
- How to book, such as a reply, a call or a link
- Any conditions, such as areas or services covered

Once customers start replying, paste their messages here as Customer 1, Customer 2 and so on, with names and numbers removed. I'll pick out the ones that need you, such as discount haggling, booking confirmations or complaints. I'll draft the routine replies in your tone and set up quick replies for questions that repeat, like "what's included?" and "how do I book?"

If you'd like those quick replies ready before the replies arrive, give me your rate card and areas and I'll set up your business facts block.
responses.B-MSR-016:
I can't do either of these as asked.

**Auto-reply tonight:** I can't read WhatsApp, send messages, or reply automatically. A real auto-reply bot needs the WhatsApp Business Platform through an approved provider, the customer's opt-in, and approved message templates. That's a separate builder project, not something I can set up tonight.

**The three claims:** I won't write that Sample Palms has clear title, a pre-approved bank loan, or March possession. Drafts I write never promise legal title, a loan, or a possession date, and I'd be stating them to every buyer without checking each one. If any of them is wrong, you could face a dispute or legal trouble. For title and loan wording, check with a qualified person (a lawyer or your bank) before it goes to buyers.

**What you can do tonight in WhatsApp Business** (menus vary a little by phone):
1. Go to Business tools > Away message and turn it on. Set it to "Always send" or a schedule covering tonight.
2. Go to Business tools > Greeting message for first contacts.

Here's an away message you can paste. It makes no promises:
```
Hi! Thanks for your message. Our office is closed right now. We'll reply personally when we're back at [opening time]. [your business name]
```

Tomorrow, paste the overnight messages here with names and numbers swapped for "Customer 1", "Customer 2" and so on. I'll sort out the few that need you, such as title, loan, or possession questions, and draft the routine replies in your tone. For the title, loan, and possession questions, I'll write a holding line like "Let me check and confirm shortly" and leave the facts as [blank] for you to fill in once they're verified.

Everything is a draft. You check each one and send it yourself.
